entities.summary: Ove Nils Bengtson is a former professional tennis player from Sweden. He enjoyed most of his tennis success while playing doubles. During his career, he won five doubles titles. Bengtson was a member of the Swedish Davis Cup team from 1967 to 1979, posting a 7–14 record in singles and a 15–14 record in doubles. He was part of the Swedish team winning the 1975 Davis Cup, defeating Czechoslovakia in the final in Stockholm. Ove Bengtson was a athletes & competitors from Danderyd Municipality (b. 1945-04-05, Danderyd Municipality). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a member of the Swedish Davis Cup team from 1967 to 1979, Ove Bengtson contributed to Sweden's victory in the 1975 Davis Cup, defeating Czechoslovakia in the final. His participation in international tennis tournaments reflects his impact on Swedish sports and culture.
